name: cfcmt-v93-final-selected-action-seed-oof-calibration-v1
purpose: Evaluate a single final-selected-action error scale while retaining frozen V93 as incumbent

model.mean_prediction: original FrozenAnchoredBlendModel constant_alpha_0p9; original antisymmetry, aggregation and reference anchoring
model.full_deployment_bundle: unchanged; used only after calibration is written for historical8171 validation

calibration.object: Error of the final argmin blended-score action relative to GP, conditional on non-reference and fixed pressure eligibility
calibration.true_target: (raw selected cost - raw GP cost) / action_group_range(full group GP-centered interval_cost contrasts), matching the model training scale
calibration.error: absolute(true normalized contrast - selected blended score)
calibration.quantile_method: weighted inverse CDF: smallest error with cumulative normalized weight >= 0.9
calibration.weights: Equal total weight per nonempty seed/scenario eligible-proposal stratum; equal eligible groups within each stratum; disclose empty strata
calibration.candidate_guard: selected score + 0.5 * frozen calibrated error quantile < 0
calibration.replaces: Entire old composite uncertainty only; no additional cycle or distance penalty, no score/ranking/pressure/executor change

validation.role: Historically exposed seed8171 development validation; excluded from model fitting and new calibration, not fresh confirmation
validation.predictor: Frozen full V93 Atlanta component with all original911 adaptation groups
validation.topology_context: Repair in memory using label-free scenario context from repaired adaptation cache; assert features and all targets unchanged; preserve source files
validation.aggregation: Equal scenarios within seed, then equal seeds
metrics: raw mean selected cost minus GP and original guard
cumulative harmful raw-cost increase and beneficial raw-cost decrease
validation.uncertainty: No confidence interval or seed-generalization significance from one validation seed

label_contract.unit: Mean active inserted plus pending insertion vehicles per controlled lane over the60-second branch

decision.scope: Use this stage to decide whether final-action calibration merits fresh validation; no closed-loop expansion based solely on one exposed historical seed

preservation.fresh56_confirmation: completed in tsc_v93_fresh_confirmation_20261106; not used to fit or select calibration
preservation.source_attribution: Separate same-capacity no-source control study; not claimed by this calibration
preservation.v158_v159: Closed historical failures are retained; no reopening or mixing their different label banks
preservation.storage: Server-only banks/models; pull compact JSON and scalar CSV only
